title: 第9章  李老师，你也不想被人知道……
slug: 四次入伍我被军区拉进黑名单
content_zh:
林毅有点懵。
他不明白，眼前这个女人是不是疯了。
他说的难道不够明白吗？还是说，他的某些行为，让李舒婉误会了？
李舒婉看着他错愕的表情，心中暗笑。
果然如此。
林毅就是在欲擒故纵！三番两次的拒绝自己，不就是为了表现出与其他男人的不同，借此吸引自己的注意力，然后让自己不自觉的去想这些事情。
只要自己没事就去想林毅，那么长久以来，就算自己根本不喜欢林毅，也会产生自己是不是喜欢他的感觉。
至此，自己就真的沦陷了。
而面对这种伎俩的唯一手段，就是直接进行到最后一步，只要林毅答应了，那更加说明，他的目的就是如此。
“李老师，抱歉，师生恋是犯法的，你也不想被人知道，你强迫学生跟你恋爱吧？”林毅说罢，没有多余的交流，他转身直接离开办公室。
李舒婉看着林毅的背影，怔在原地愣神。
他这是……又拒绝了我？
他还在欲擒故纵？他还在钓！
他……他到底想干什么啊！
这女人绝对有病！
刚走出办公室，林毅就暗骂了句。
但复读这事已经定下了，也没办法换班主任，索性就这么着吧。
既然知道这女人有病，以后就尽量不要跟她牵扯上关系就是了。
而且等开学后，她是老师，自己是学生，师生关系，井水不犯河水。
林毅掏出手机，熟练拨通了发小的电话。

电话接通的瞬间，对面立刻传来一道亢奋无比的大嗓门：“喂？哪位？”
林毅语气随意：“我，林毅，回来了。”
电话那头死寂片刻，随即爆发出震天的欢呼声。
“卧槽！毅哥？！你退伍回来了？真的假的？！卧槽，卧槽！”
“我还以为你又在部队循环入伍折腾呢！你在哪呢？等着我！今天必须出来玩！我安排！好好给你接风洗尘！”
林毅看了看身后的校门：“烟城一中门口，麻溜的。”
“得嘞，毅哥，五分钟！”
KTV内灯光闪耀。
桌上摆满啤酒、小吃、果盘，满地空瓶。
几个发小拿着话筒扯着嗓子唱歌，一人身边搂着两个打扮妖艳，身着暴露的公主。
一边享受着公主们无微不至的喂水果，一边听着公主们的吹捧，开怀大笑。
唯独角落的沙发上，林毅独自靠着椅背，显得格格不入。
六年军营，日复一日是嘹亮号声、枯燥训练、战术体能、铁血纪律。
这种灯红酒绿、纸醉金迷的喧闹玩乐，对这些他非常的陌生。
看着眼前一群人疯闹喝酒、肆意放纵的样子，林毅心里半点波澜没有，甚至隐隐有些烦躁、不适应。
有点无聊啊……突然就想跑步了？
妈的，我是有病吧，好不容易从军营里跑出来了，虽说未来还是要回军营的，但现在享受享受怎么了？没问题吧！
可越是这么想，林毅的心里就越是不得劲，就总觉得这地方待不下去了。
“你们玩，我出去透透气。”
林毅随口跟身边的发小交代一声，直接起身，慢悠悠走出喧闹的包厢。

走廊铺着厚地毯，隔绝了大半噪音，总算清净了不少。
可刚走出没两步，一道清冷高挑的身影迎面走来。
一身简约私服，长发披肩，眉眼清冷，气质绝尘，正是李舒婉。
四目相对。
两人脚步同时一顿。
林毅眉梢微挑，眼底掠过一丝意外，笑着打招呼：“李老师？这么巧，你也来这儿玩？”
李舒婉脚步停住，清冷的眸子看着他。
她是来这里找人的，却没想到在这能碰到林毅。
她扫了眼身后敞开的包厢门。
门内光影摇晃，男男女女嬉笑打闹，不少人喝酒搂抱、举止随意，乌烟瘴气的场面一览无余。
呵呵，果然就是个花花公子罢了。
但被这种人接连拒绝……真的很不舒服。
她面无表情道：“是挺巧的。”
林毅自然听出了对方话里的阴阳，也懒得解释：“看这样子，李老师也是过来聚会的？哪个包厢？所有消费算我的，当学生请老师，理所应当。”
李舒婉眼神更冷一分：“不用，不必让林同学破费。”
林毅心里暗自嗤笑一声。
女人就是女人，这别扭劲儿真是没谁了。
林毅从不纠缠，比了个手势：“行，既然不用，那就当我没说，拜拜，李老师。”
说完，半点停留没有，转身径直走回自己的包厢。
李舒婉一时语塞，站在原地僵了好几秒。

但看了看林毅的背影，她眯了眯眼睛，并没有说什么，转身离开。
回到包厢后。
林毅心里的烦躁更浓了。
他确实融不进这种玩乐氛围，拍了拍还在唱歌的发小肩膀：“我有点事，先走了，你们慢慢玩。”
发小一脸懵：“不是毅哥？刚来没多久怎么就走了？再多坐会啊！”
“不了，待不惯。”
林毅摇摇头，懒得多解释。
傍晚时分。
夕阳落山，天色渐暗。
林毅回到家时，刚好临近饭点。
他进门没多做停留，径直走回房间，换掉身上的休闲衣物，翻出那套压得平整的作训服换上。
他顺手抓起墙边的运动鞋，正要出门。
客厅里正在端菜收拾餐桌的王秀兰看见他这一身打扮：“马上就要吃饭了，你换衣服去哪？先坐下吃饭。”
林毅系好鞋带，抬头淡淡回道：“妈，你们先吃，不用等我，我出去跑一会。”
不等母亲再劝，他推门而出。
晚风微凉。
林毅调整呼吸、迈开步幅，完全是部队标准的长跑节奏，起跑、匀速、换气、摆臂，每一个动作都是肌肉记忆，不用刻意思考，行云流水。
一圈、两圈……
五公里，不长不短，刚好是他日复一日刻在骨子里的训练量。
全程跑完，气息平稳，浑身热血沸腾，筋骨彻底舒展开来。

晚风拂过湿透的额发，林毅停下脚步，拉伸了下身体喘了口气，脸上露出松弛的笑容。
“呼！舒服。”
但紧接着，他表情一僵：“妈的，真是被部队改造透了。”
“一天不跑五公里，浑身都别扭，坐立难安，这下好了，退伍了，习惯改不掉了……老爸，爷爷，看你们干的好事！真服了。”
但也无妨，未来肯定还是要回部队的，这每天五公里的习惯，还有整理内务的习惯不能丢。
毕竟，丢起来容易，但要重新捡起来可就难了。
休息片刻，林毅转身踱步回家。
推开家门，餐厅里灯火明亮，饭菜已经摆满一桌。
爷爷林建军、父亲林国栋、母亲王秀兰三人正坐在餐桌前准备吃饭。
看见满头薄汗、一身作训服的林毅进门，王秀兰连忙招手：“回来了？快洗手吃饭，菜还热着呢。”
餐桌上，气氛算不上压抑，却也算不上轻松。
不过已经要比他第一天回来的时候，好多了。
林国栋抬眼扫过他身上的作训服时一怔：“出去跑步了？”
“嗯，五公里。”林毅随口应了一声，走向洗手间洗手。
一直沉默端坐的老爷子林建军，此刻居然微微点头，语气难得带着一丝赞许：“嗯，挺好，退伍了还能保持自律，没荒废底子。”
“看来，他这是铁了心要回部队啊。”林建军补了句。
林毅表情一顿。
爷爷这么说，是同意自己重回部队了？
那这么说，他不用苦哈哈的走复读这条路了？
content_en:
Ji Yi was a little confused.
He didn't understand if the woman in front of him was crazy.
Wasn't what he said clear enough? Or was it that Li Shuwan misunderstood some of his actions?
Li Shuwan looked at his stunned expression and smiled secretly in her heart.
Sure enough.
Lin Yi is playing hard to get! The reason for rejecting myself again and again is not to show that I am different from other men, so as to attract my attention, and then make myself think about these things unconsciously.
As long as you have nothing to do, you will think about Ji Yi. For a long time, even if you don't like Ji Yi at all, you will still have a feeling of whether you like him or not.
At this point, I have really fallen.
The only way to face this kind of trick is to go directly to the last step. As long as Ji Yi agrees, it further proves that this is his purpose.
"Teacher Li, I'm sorry, teacher-student love is against the law. You don't want anyone to know, so you force students to fall in love with you, right?" After Lin Yi said this, without any unnecessary communication, he turned and left the office.
Li Shuwan looked at Ji Yi's back, stunned in place.
Is he... rejecting me again?
Is he still playing hard to get? He is still fishing!
He... what on earth does he want to do!
This woman is definitely sick!
As soon as he walked out of the office, Ji Yi cursed secretly.
But the matter of re-study has been decided, and there is no way to change the class teacher, so let’s just leave it at that.
Now that you know this woman is sick, just try not to get involved with her in the future.
Moreover, when school starts, she will be a teacher and she will be a student. The teacher-student relationship will not conflict with each other.
Ji Yi took out his mobile phone and dialed the small number skillfully.
The moment the call was connected, a loud and excited voice came from the other side: "Hello? Who is this?"
Ji Yi's tone was casual: "I, Lin Yi, am back."
There was a moment of dead silence on the other end of the phone, and then there was a loud cheer.
"Holy shit! Brother Yi?! Are you back from the army? Really or not?! Damn it, shit!"
"I thought you were re-enlisting in the army again! Where are you? Wait for me! You must come out to play today! I will arrange it! I will give you a good start!"
Ji Yi looked at the school gate behind him: "The entrance to Yancheng No. 1 Middle School is so slippery."
"Okay, Brother Yi, five minutes!"
The lights in the KTV are shining.
The table is filled with beer, snacks, and fruit plates, and the floor is covered with empty bottles.
Several teenagers held microphones and sang at the top of their lungs. One of them was surrounded by two princesses dressed in coquettish and scantily clad clothes.
While enjoying the meticulous feeding of fruits by the princesses, I listened to the compliments of the princesses and laughed heartily.
Only on the sofa in the corner, Ji Yi leaned against the back of the chair alone, looking out of place.
Six years in the military camp were filled with loud bugles, boring training, tactical physical fitness, and iron-blooded discipline day after day.
He was very unfamiliar with this kind of noisy fun with feasting and revelry.
Seeing the group of people in front of him drinking wildly and indulgently, Ji Yi felt completely unperturbed, and even felt a little irritated and uncomfortable.
A little boring... suddenly want to run?
Damn it, I must be sick. I finally ran out of the military camp. Although I will still go back to the military camp in the future, what’s wrong with enjoying it now? No problem!
But the more he thought about it, the more unhappy Ji Yi felt, feeling that he couldn't stay in this place anymore.
"You guys play, I'll go out and get some air."
Ji Yi casually told the boy next to him, stood up directly, and slowly walked out of the noisy box.
The corridor was covered with thick carpets, which blocked out most of the noise, making it finally a lot cleaner.
But as soon as he took two steps, a cold and tall figure came towards him.
Dressed in simple private clothes, with long hair shawl, cold eyebrows, and an impeccable temperament, she is none other than Li Shuwan.
Eyes facing each other.
The two of them paused at the same time.
Lin Yi raised his eyebrows slightly, a hint of surprise flashed across his eyes, and greeted with a smile: "Mr. Li? What a coincidence, youCome here to play too? "
Li Shuwan stopped and looked at him with cold eyes.
She came here to find someone, but she didn't expect to meet Ji Yi here.
She glanced at the open box door behind her.
The light and shadow inside the door swayed, men and women were laughing and playing, many people were drinking and hugging each other, behaving casually, and the smoky scene was clearly visible.
Haha, he is just a playboy after all.
But being rejected by this kind of person one after another... is really uncomfortable.
She said expressionlessly: "It's quite a coincidence. "
Lin Yi naturally heard the yin and yang in the other party's words, and didn't bother to explain: "Look, Teacher Li is also here for the party? Which box? All consumption is mine, and it is natural for a student to hire a teacher. "
Li Shuwan's eyes turned even colder: "No, you don't have to waste money on Classmate Lin. "
Lin Yi sneered secretly in his heart.
Women are women, and there is really no one else who is so awkward.
Ji Yi never bothered and gestured: "Okay, since you don't need it, just pretend I didn't say it, bye, Teacher Li. "
After saying that, without stopping at all, he turned around and walked straight back to his box.
Li Shuwan was speechless for a moment and stood frozen for several seconds.
But looking at Ji Yi's back, she squinted her eyes, turned around and left without saying anything.
After returning to the box.
Ji Yi's irritability became even stronger.
He really couldn't get into this fun atmosphere, so he patted Fa Xiao on the shoulder who was still singing: "I have something to do, so I'm leaving now. You guys can play slowly. "
Fa Xiao looked confused: "Not Brother Yi? Why did you leave so soon after you arrived? Sit down for a while longer! "
"No, I can't stand it. "
Ji Yi shook his head, too lazy to explain.
Late afternoon.
The sun sets and the sky becomes dark.
When Ji Yi returned home, it was just about time for dinner.
He didn't pause much after entering, and walked straight back to the room, changed out of his casual clothes, and took out the flattened training clothes and put them on.
He grabbed the sneakers by the wall and was about to go out.
Wang Xiulan, who was serving food and clearing the table in the living room, saw him dressed like this: "It's time to eat soon, where are you going to change clothes? Sit down and eat first. "
Ji Yi tied his shoelaces, raised his head and replied calmly: "Mom, you guys eat first, don't wait for me, I'll go out for a run. "
Without waiting for his mother's further persuasion, he pushed open the door and walked out.
The evening breeze is slightly cool.
Ji Yi adjusts his breathing and strides, which is exactly the standard long-distance running rhythm of the army. Starting, keeping a constant speed, breathing, and swinging arms, every movement is muscle memory, without deliberate thinking, and flows smoothly.
One lap, two laps...
Five kilometers, neither long nor short, was just the amount of training that was engraved in his bones day after day.
After running the whole race, my breath was steady, my blood was boiling, and my muscles and bones were completely relaxed.
The evening breeze blew through his wet forehead. Ji Yi stopped, stretched his body and took a breath, with a relaxed smile on his face.
"Huh! Comfortable. "
But then, his expression froze: "Damn, I was really transformed by the army. "
"If I don't run five kilometers a day, I feel awkward all over and can't sit still. Now I'm fine. I'm retired and I can't change my habit... Dad, grandpa, look at the good things you have done! Really convinced. "
But it doesn't matter. I will definitely return to the army in the future. I can't lose the habit of five kilometers every day and the habit of cleaning up housework.
After all, it’s easy to throw something away, but hard to pick it up again.
After a short rest, Ji Yi turned around and walked home.
When I opened the door, the dining room was brightly lit and the table was already full of food.
Grandpa Lin Jianjun, father Lin Guodong, and mother Wang Xiulan are sitting at the dining table preparing to eat.
Seeing Lin Yi, who was covered in sweat and dressed in training uniform, come in, Wang Xiulan waved quickly: "You're back? Wash your hands and eat quickly, the food is still hot. "
At the dinner table, the atmosphere was not depressing, but it was not relaxed either.
But it was much better than when he came back on the first day.
Lin Guodong was startled when he glanced at his training uniform: "Going out for a run? "
"Well, five kilometers. "Jin Yi responded casually and walked to the bathroom to wash his hands.
The old man Lin Jianjun, who had been sitting silently, actually nodded slightly at this moment, with a rare hint of approval in his tone: "Well, it's good. After being discharged from the army, I can still maintain self-discipline without losing my foundation. "
"It seems that he is determined to return to the army. " Lin Jianjun added.
Ji Yi's expression paused.
Grandpa said this, did he agree to return to the army?
So, he doesn’t have to go through the painful process of repeating his studies?
